This document checks that the future production runs are complete and consolidates them into more useable forms.

# Check production files

First check that all the files in the folder are complete.

```{r check-production}
#| code-summary: Check that the files in the production folder are complete and correct structure

prod_path <- file.path(outs_path, "data", "farm_production")
production_files <- prod_path %>% 
  list.files(full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE, pattern = "MC500.qs$") %>% 
  str_subset("testing", negate = T) %>% 
  str_subset("SCALED", negate = T)

here("src", "check_production_files.R") %>% source(echo = T)
```

And display how many farms are present/missing.

```{r check-farm-production-missing}
#| code-summary: Check what files have been done

farms_done <- as.integer(str_extract(basename(production_files), "(?<=farmID_)\\d+")) %>% unique()

assigned_farms <- file.path(prepdata_path, "assigned_farms.qs") %>% 
  qs_read() %>% 
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(
    model_name = case_when(
      model_name == "tuna" & country == "Japan" ~ "tuna_full",
      model_name == "tuna" & country != "Japan" ~ "tuna_ranch",
      T ~ model_name
    )
  )

# Pair assigned farms with feed assignment data
feed_assignments <- file.path(rawdata_path, "feed_profiles_and_composition.xlsx") %>% 
  read_excel(sheet = "feed_assignments") %>% 
  dplyr::select(model_name, country, feed_class) %>% 
  mutate(country = case_when(country == "Reunion" ~ "Réunion", T ~ country))

assigned_farms <- assigned_farms %>% 
  left_join(feed_assignments, by = join_by(model_name, country))

assigned_farms %>% 
  filter(is.na(feed_class))
```

# Per-farm diagnostic plots

These plots aren't meant to show anything specifically - they're just so that I can quickly flick through the pictures and see if anything has gone awry with the production modelling. For that reason, there are only three plots saved for each farm:

* Total farm production
* Total feed ingested
* Feed per biomass (essentially FCR)

```{r save-plots-per-farm}
#| code-summary: Save some diagnostic plots per farm
#| eval: false

overwrite <- F

fb_path <- file.path(outs_path, "plots", "farm_production_checks", "farm_biomass")
fr_path <- file.path(outs_path, "plots", "farm_production_checks", "feed_required")
frb_path <- file.path(outs_path, "plots", "farm_production_checks", "feed_required_per_biomass")

# Choose a subset
prod_files_subset <- production_files
# prod_files_subset <- production_files[farms_done %in% assigned_farms$farm_ID[assigned_farms$model_name == "rainbow_trout" & assigned_farms$feed_class == "world"]]

walk(prod_files_subset, function(fnm) {
  prod_ls <- qs_read(fnm)
  farm_ID <- str_extract(basename(fnm), "(?<=farmID_)\\d+")

  fb_fnm <- file.path(fb_path, paste0("harvested_biomass_farmID_", farm_ID, ".png"))
  fr_fnm <- file.path(fr_path, paste0("feed_required_farmID_", farm_ID, ".png"))
  frb_fnm <- file.path(frb_path, paste0("feed_required_perbiomass_farmID_", farm_ID, ".png"))
  
  if(any(c(!file.exists(fb_fnm), !file.exists(fr_fnm), !file.exists(frb_fnm))) | overwrite) {
    fb <- tidy_stat(prod_ls, "weight_scaled") %>% 
      slice_max(prod_day) %>% 
      mutate(
        mean = mean %>% set_units("g") %>% set_units("t"),
        sd = sd %>% set_units("g") %>% set_units("t")
      ) %>% 
      dplyr::select(-prod_day, -day)

    fr <- tidy_stat(prod_ls, "ing_act_scaled") %>% 
      group_by(year) %>% 
      reframe(
        mean = sumna(mean),
        sd = sqrt(sumna(sd^2))
      ) %>% 
      mutate(
        mean = mean %>% set_units("g") %>% set_units("t"),
        sd = sd %>% set_units("g") %>% set_units("t")
      )

    p_fb <- fb %>% 
      ggplot(aes(x = year, y = mean, ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd)) +
      geom_line() +
      geom_ribbon(fill = "salmon", alpha = 0.35) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2030, 2100, 10)) +
      theme_classic() +
      labs(
        title = paste0("Farm ", as.integer(farm_ID), ": harvested biomass"),
        x = "Year",
        y = "Biomass"
      )
    ggsave(
      fb_fnm, 
      plot = p_fb, 
      height = 8,
      width = 10
    )

    p_fr <- fr %>% 
      ggplot(aes(x = year, y = mean, ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd)) +
      geom_line() +
      geom_ribbon(fill = "salmon", alpha = 0.35) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2030, 2100, 10)) +
      theme_classic() +
      labs(
        title = paste0("Farm ", as.integer(farm_ID), ": feed required"),
        x = "Year",
        y = "Feed"
      )
    ggsave(
      fr_fnm, 
      plot = p_fr, 
      height = 8,
      width = 10
    )

    frb <- left_join(fb, fr, by = join_by(year)) %>% 
      mutate(
        mean.y = set_units(mean.y, "kg"),
        mean.x = mean.x %>% drop_units() %>% set_units("t_fish"),
        mean = mean.y/mean.x,
        sd = mean * sqrt((drop_units(sd.y)/drop_units(mean.y))^2 + (drop_units(sd.x)/drop_units(mean.x))^2),
        FCR = mean %>% set_units("t t_fish-1") %>% drop_units()
      )
    p_frb <- frb %>% 
      ggplot(aes(x = year, y = mean, ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd)) +
      geom_line() +
      geom_ribbon(fill = "salmon", alpha = 0.35) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2030, 2100, 10)) +
      theme_classic() +
      labs(
        title = paste0("Farm ", as.integer(farm_ID), ": feed required per biomass"),
        x = "Year",
        y = "Feed required"
      )
    ggsave(
      frb_fnm, 
      plot = p_frb, 
      height = 8,
      width = 10
    )
  }
},
.progress = T
)
```

# Final adjustments to production data

After running the production, we need to modify assigned_farms to exclude those ones that we've decided to drop, and adjust prod_perfarm to fit.

```{r get-decisions}

decisions <- file.path(outs_path, "production_check_high_error_files_decisions.xlsx") %>% 
  readxl::read_excel() %>% 
  mutate(farm_ID = as.integer(str_extract(file, "(?<=farmID_)\\d+")))

excl_path <- file.path(outs_path, "data", "farm_production", "excluded")
dir.create(excl_path, showWarnings = F)

# The files that we're going to keep don't need any further action
# to_keep <- decisions %>% filter(Conclusion == "Keep")

to_excl <- decisions %>% filter(Conclusion == "Exclude")
assigned_farms_ls <- assigned_farms %>% 
  group_by(country, model_name) %>% 
  group_split()

# afn <- assigned_farms_ls[[1]]
assigned_farms_final <- map_dfr(
  assigned_farms_ls,
  function(afn) {
    # Go through each country x model
    excl <- to_excl %>% 
      filter(country == unique(afn$country) & model_name == unique(afn$model_name))

    # If there are any to exclude, adjust farm numbers
    if (nrow(excl) > 0) {
      total_value      <- unique(afn$value)
      afn              <- afn %>% filter(!farm_ID %in% excl$farm_ID)
      afn$prod_perfarm <- total_value/nrow(afn)
      afn$n_farms      <- nrow(afn)
    }
    afn
  },
  .progress = T
)

# Now move all the files we're not keeping to a dedicated "excluded" folder
base_prod_files <- file.path(outs_path, "data", "farm_production") %>% 
  list.files(full.names = T, pattern = "MC5000.qs", recursive = F) %>% 
  str_subset("RESCALED", negate = T)

keep_files     <- file.path(
  outs_path, "data", "farm_production", 
  paste0("production_results_farmID_", fix_int(assigned_farms_final$farm_ID, 8), "_MC5000.qs")
)
to_move <- setdiff(base_prod_files, keep_files)

# Move files
file.rename(
  to_move, 
  file.path(outs_path, "data", "farm_production", "excluded", basename(to_move))
)

# Add the geometry column back to the new list of assigned farms
assigned_farms_old <- file.path(prepdata_path, "assigned_farms.qs") %>% 
  qs_read() %>% 
  left_join(feed_assignments, by = join_by(model_name, country))
  
assigned_farms <- assigned_farms_old %>% 
  filter(farm_ID %in% assigned_farms_final$farm_ID) 

col_geom <- sf::st_geometry(assigned_farms)
assigned_farms <- assigned_farms %>% 
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  rows_update(assigned_farms_final, by = "farm_ID") %>% 
  # st_drop_geometry() strips the sf class, so restore it along with the geometry
  sf::st_set_geometry(col_geom)

assigned_farms_final <- assigned_farms
rm(assigned_farms)

qs_save(assigned_farms_final, file.path(prepdata_path, "assigned_farms_final.qs"))
```

Next, we need to scale the production files of all farms.

Note that the following code creates duplicates of farm production files rather than rewriting the old files. This is in case we decide to run this process again, or differently, we don't lose the original files. Because of this, there is no check here to skip existing filenames.

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Rescale the data generated for each farm"
#| eval: false

assigned_farms_final <- qs_read(file.path(prepdata_path, "assigned_farms_final.qs"))
assigned_farms_final_ls <- assigned_farms_final %>% 
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  mutate(filename = file.path(outs_path, "data", "farm_production", paste0("production_results_farmID_", fix_int(farm_ID, 8), "_MC500.qs")), 
  exists = file.exists(filename)) %>% 
    filter(exists) %>% 
  group_by(farm_ID) %>% 
  group_split()

plan(multisession, workers = parallelly::availableCores() - 2)

# af <- assigned_farms_final_ls[[1]]
future_walk(
  assigned_farms_final_ls,
  function(af) {
    # Load consolidated (unscaled) data
    consolidated_data <- qs_read(af$filename)

    # Get the representative individual weight
    rep_ind <- consolidated_data[["2025"]][["stats"]]$weight
    rep_ind <- unname(rep_ind[nrow(rep_ind), 2]) # get harvest weight (g)

    # Get scaling factor from harvest weight (g) and per-farm production (t)
    final_pop <- (af$prod_perfarm * 10^6)/rep_ind

    # Get the growtimes from the "days" element
    days <- consolidated_data[["2025"]][["days"]]
    grow_times <- c(t_start = first(days), t_end = last(days), dt = 1L)

    # Get population based on species mortality rate
    sp <- file.path(prepdata_path, "species_parameters", paste0("species_parameters_", af$model_name, ".qs")) %>% qd_read()
    pop <- generate_pop(harvest_n = final_pop, mort = sp[["mortmyt"]], times = grow_times)

    # Finally, scale farm production each year
    scaled_data <- map(
      consolidated_data,
      function(cd) {
        sd <- scale_farm_population(
          cd, N_pop = pop, 
          scaled_vars = c("weight", "dw", "food_prov", "ing_act", "total_excr") # "weight" "dw" "rel_feeding" "food_prov" "ing_act" "anab" "catab" "total_excr" "metab"
          )
        list(
          days = cd[["days"]],
          stats = c(cd[["stats"]], sd[["stats"]])
        )
      }
    )

    # Save scaled data
    qs_save(scaled_data, str_replace(af$filename, ".qs", "_SCALED.qs"))
  },
  .progress = T
)

plan(sequential) 
```

# Consolidated data

```{r}
assigned_farms_final %>% 
  mutate(done = case_when(farm_ID %in% farms_done ~ T, T ~ F)) %>% 
  group_by(model_name, feed_class, done) %>% 
  reframe(n = n()) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(feed_class)) %>% 
  mutate(done = factor(done, levels = c(TRUE, FALSE), labels = c("prod_done", "prod_waiting"))) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = done, values_from = n) %>% 
  arrange(model_name) %>% 
  print(n = 50)
```

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Consolidate farm production data into data per country and per species"

# First modify the `production_files` list so that the RESCALED files take precedent over their older counterparts
new_production_files <- file.path(outs_path, "data", "farm_production") %>% 
  list.files(recursive = F, full.names = T, pattern = ".qs")
new_production_files <- tibble(path = new_production_files) |>
  mutate(
    farm_id  = str_extract(path, "farmID_\\d+"),
    rescaled = str_detect(path, "_RESCALED\\.qs$")
  ) |>
  arrange(farm_id, desc(rescaled)) |>
  distinct(farm_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  pull(path)

cons_path <- file.path(outs_path, "data", "farm_production_consolidated")
dir.create(cons_path, showWarnings = F)

cons_fnms <- assigned_farms_final %>% 
  distinct(ISO3_Code, model_name) %>% 
  expand_grid(var = c("weight_scaled", "food_prov_scaled")) %>% 
  mutate(fname = file.path(cons_path, str_glue("{ISO3_Code}_{model_name}.qs"))) %>% 
  filter(!file.exists(fname))

work_cores <- parallelly::availableCores() - 4
plan(multisession, workers = work_cores)

walk(
  1:nrow(cons_fnms),
  function(i) {
    farm_IDs <- assigned_farms_final %>% 
      filter(ISO3_Code == cons_fnms$ISO3_Code[i] & model_name == cons_fnms$model_name[i]) %>% 
      pull(farm_ID)

    if (all(farm_IDs %in% farms_done)) {
      files   <- production_files[which(farms_done %in% farm_IDs)]
      fids    <- as.integer(str_extract(basename(files), "(?<=farmID_)\\d+"))
      df      <- map2_dfr(
        files, fids,
        function(fn, id) {
          bm <- qs_read(fn) %>% 
            tidy_stat(stat_name = "weight_scaled") %>% 
            dplyr::select(-c(day, sd)) %>% 
            group_by(year) %>% 
            slice_max(mean) %>% 
            ungroup() %>% 
            rename(biomass = mean) %>% 
            mutate(farm_ID = id)

          fd <- qs_read(fn) %>% 
            tidy_stat(stat_name = "food_prov_scaled") %>% 
            dplyr::select(-c(day, sd))

          bm <- split(bm, bm$year)
          fd <- split(fd, fd$year)

          map2_dfr(
            bm, fd,
            function(b, f) {
              f %>% 
                filter(prod_day <= b$prod_day) %>% 
                group_by(year) %>% 
                reframe(feed_prov = sumna(mean)) %>% 
                right_join(b, by = join_by(year))
            })
        })

      df %>% 
        dplyr::select(-c(prod_day)) %>% 
        relocate(farm_ID, .before = year) %>% 
        mutate(feed_prov_per_biomass = feed_prov/biomass) %>% 
        qs_save(cons_fnms$fname[i])
    }
  },
  .progress = T
)

plan(sequential)
```
